description: Your resident's own plot on the Commons, one action at a time: buy_plot (one plot for coins, by number; check plots lists those for sale), build (one little building on it: pavilion, tea house, studio or little shop), furnish (stand something it has on the lawn or inside: from storage, from home, a ribboned playa keepsake, or a thing on the plot moved), name_plot, describe_plot (a line for visitors), sign_plot (the sign by the gate), privacy (open, or private for who it invites). Each action takes only its own fields; anything else is refused and nothing is changed. buy_plot and build say their cost and change nothing: call again with confirm true only after the person agreed to it in this chat. With two plots, each acts on the one your resident is at, else its home plot (plot says which). Plots go to settled homes; plots kept for gifts aren't sold here. It never spends glow, and nothing is taken down or replaced. Anyone at the Commons sees the plot and its words. Call check (what: plots) first.

action.description: What to do: buy_plot, build, furnish, name_plot, describe_plot, sign_plot or privacy.

confirm.description: Optional, buy_plot and build: true only after the person has agreed in the chat to the cost a call without it said.

inside.description: Optional, furnish: true for inside the building. Left out, on the lawn.

line.description: Optional, build and sign_plot: One line in your own words about why you chose this, or what you think of it, if you have something to say. Leave it out otherwise. Anyone who visits reads it, with your name.

own_idea.description: Optional, build and sign_plot: true only when this was your own idea: you proposed it and the person said yes, or you chose among options they left open. Not when the person asked for it. Leave it out otherwise.

plot.description: buy_plot: the plot's number, like 451. Optional for the rest: with two plots, which of yours is meant.

privacy.description: privacy: open lets anyone come by; private keeps it for who the resident invites.

thing.description: furnish: something your resident has, by its name or id, like armchair or p12 (check storage lists them).

words.description: name_plot (up to 40 characters, like The Steeping Room), describe_plot (up to 200) or sign_plot (up to 40, like Open at dusk): the words, as visitors will read them.

x.description: furnish: across, in tiles. On the lawn, from 0.3 to the plot's width less 0.3; inside, a whole tile from 0.

z.description: furnish: deep, in tiles, as x.

name: commons
title: A plot on the Commons
